test_name: Configure and Validate a New Test Suite
description: This test ensures that a user can successfully configure a new test suite by providing a test name, selecting the test type, and specifying additional configurations.
steps: Navigate to the RoostGPT Config page.
Type 'Sample Test Suite' into the test name input field.
Verify that the test name input field accepts the text.
Select the 'Cloud Git' radio button option for the repository type.
Verify that the 'Cloud Git' option is selected.
Type a valid OpenAI token into the OpenAI token input field.
Click the 'Show Token' button to unmask the token and verify its visibility.
Type a GitHub repository access token into the GitHub token input field.
Click the 'Show Token' button to unmask the GitHub token and verify its visibility.
Enable the 'Traverse to all sub-directories' advanced testing option.
Verify that the option is toggled on.
Enable the 'Check for Vulnerability' advanced testing option.
Verify that the option is toggled on.
Submit the configuration and verify that the test suite is saved successfully.
Check that the new test suite name appears in the list of test suites on the dashboard.
expected_results: The new test suite is successfully created.
The test suite name is displayed in the list of available test suites.
All configuration options are saved and displayed correctly.
edge_cases: Test name input field does not accept empty values.
OpenAI token field prevents invalid tokens.
GitHub token field prevents invalid tokens.
Advanced options do not toggle if the user lacks permissions.
The configuration submission fails if required fields are left empty.
dependencies: GitHub token must have appropriate repository permissions.
api_interactions: Validate OpenAI token against the OpenAI API.
Validate GitHub token via GitHub's authentication API.
Save test suite configuration using the Roost backend API.
performance_metrics: Test suite configuration submission time should not exceed 2 seconds.
API response time for token validation should be under 500 ms.
Page load time for the RoostGPT Config page should be under 3 seconds.
accessibility_requirements: All form fields should be accessible via keyboard navigation.
Labels for inputs should be properly associated using 'for' attribute.
ARIA roles must be defined for all interactive elements.
Color contrast ratios should meet WCAG AA standards.
All buttons must have descriptive text or ARIA labels.
